description:
• Brand introduction:At Brazy Wickz, we are passionate about creating high-quality, all-natural candles that inspire creativity and promote relaxation. We believe that candles have the power to transform any space into a warm and inviting sanctuary, and we strive to create unique and beautiful candles that reflect our customers' individual styles and personalities.  
• Product description: Our candles are hand-poured using only the finest ingredients, including natural soy wax, premium fragrance oils, and natural wicks. We take pride in the fact that our candles are environmentally friendly, and we never use harmful chemicals or additives in our products. 
• USP (Unique Selling Point):

Artisanal Craftsmanship: Each Brazy Wickz candle is meticulously handcrafted with utmost care and attention to detail, making them truly unique and one-of-a-kind.

Creative Designs: Our candles feature captivating and innovative designs that add a touch of artistry to any space, elevating the ambiance and aesthetics of your surroundings.

Natural Ingredients: Brazy Wickz candles are made from premium, eco-friendly materials, ensuring a clean and sustainable burn that's safe for you and the environment.

Long-Lasting Burn: Experience extended hours of soothing candlelight, thanks to our candles' extended burn time, providing you with lasting tranquility and relaxation.

Personalized Touch: We offer custom candle options, allowing you to create a bespoke piece tailored to your preferences or to make a meaningful gift that resonates with your loved ones.

Locally Sourced: Brazy Wickz is committed to supporting local communities by sourcing ingredients and materials from trusted, nearby suppliers.

Environmentally Conscious Packaging: Our candles come in sustainable and aesthetically pleasing packaging, further emphasizing our commitment to eco-friendly practices.

• Payment terms: All accepted sales will be payed out via E-Transfer, Paypay or Bank Transfer. Payments are made monthly with a minimum balance of $50. If the affiliate does not reach $50 within that month, the accured funds will be transfered into next months payment cycle.
• Other information: Please see Terms and Conditions.
